# Mac Brown Construction, LLC

> Licensed custom home builder and general contractor in Bryson City, North Carolina (Swain County), established in 1988. Holds a North Carolina Unlimited General Contractor License. Builds energy-efficient custom homes, cabins, and timber frame hybrid homes in Western North Carolina and the Great Smoky Mountains, using ICF foundations, frost-proof footings, P-2000 and foam insulation, radiant floors, geothermal ground loops, and passive solar design.

- Phone: (828) 736-1469
- Email: macbrownconstruction@gmail.com
- Address: 779 W Deep Creek Rd, Bryson City, NC 28713
- Service area: Bryson City, Swain County, Jackson County, Macon County, Cherokee, Sylva, Waynesville, and surrounding Western North Carolina

## Blog

- [Frost Proof Footings](https://macbrownconstruction.com/foundations/frost-proof-footings/): Using 2-inch EPS foam with ICF foundations to stop conductive heat loss into frozen ground
- [Timber Frame Hybrid Construction](https://macbrownconstruction.com/wall-plates/timber-frame-hybrid-construction/): Local hardwood timber framing combined with wide wall plates and P-2000 encasement
